instructions_to_main_agent: Design Archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast. The app must feel authoritative, objective, and dense, suitable for an enterprise fintech/HR tool. Absolutely no purple or teal gradients.

Borders & Surfaces: Do not use rounded corners. Everything must use `rounded-none` to enforce a rigid, 'control room' architectural feel. Drop shadows should be absent; use 1px solid borders (`border-zinc-200` or `border-zinc-300`) to separate elements.

Typography Rule: Add font imports to CSS. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold, striking headers. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for all readable body text, buttons, and labels. Use 'JetBrains Mono' EXCLUSIVELY for all numeric data (salaries, taxes, BPJS values, NIK/IDs) so the digits align perfectly and convey precision.
Single-Metric Hero: Ensure the Dashboard prominently displays 'Total Payroll Bulan Ini' using a massive size (e.g., text-5xl JetBrains Mono) before showing smaller supplementary cards.

Data Density: Avoid 'cramped' designs but minimize wasted white space. Table columns should be compact, headers must be `uppercase tracking-widest text-[11px]`. Right-align all numeric/currency columns for clear scanability.

Form & Input Strategy: Forms should not look like consumer web forms. Use dense, bordered layouts for configurations (tunjangan, potongan, rate BPJS, PPh 21 progressive tiers). Inputs must have high contrast focus states (`focus:ring-[#002FA7] focus:border-[#002FA7]`).

Payslip Print Layout: The Payslip view must be printable. Wrap it in a container that mimics an A4 paper dimension, use stark black-and-white colors, remove sidebars, and apply standard `@media print` tailwind classes so HR can press Ctrl+P easily.

Interactive Elements: Ensure hover states explicitly alter text and background colors for accessibility (e.g., table row hovers). Utilize the exact testing attributes provided across all major interactive elements.
